eligibility.reason: E1/E4: the source-build log names the missing declaration. E2: MAVROS consumes the separately generated/released MAVLink C++ interface; moving a message between dialect namespaces changes that interface, not just dependency resolution. E3: UPGRADE is supported by 2025.12.12 failure and 2025.9.9 rollback success. Stop at 6.

failed_conditions.quote: MAVLink move some of messages between dialects, that's not a problem for the protocol itself or C implementation, but for C++ it is because here i have a namespace for each dialect.
failed_conditions.reason: Agree element_removed_or_renamed and api:mavlink::common::msg::GLOBAL_POSITION_INT. The fix changes common::msg to standard::msg. Inspection of both release XMLs confirms message 33 moved from common.xml to standard.xml. Cascading gpos member errors do not establish independent field removals.

loudness.reason: The compiler explicitly rejects the missing namespace-qualified declaration. This is loud_documented at build, regardless of whether the MAVLink wire layout remains compatible.

detection_stage.reason: The documented failure is detected at build, not inferred from the location of the eventual edit.

resolution.quote: Ah, i overlooked https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/commit/42d26080d197f173947e8636abc6bbd295acb07a - so, i'll release 2.14.0 today.
resolution.reason: Agree recommended for the specified forward-fixed composition: the maintainer identifies the correcting commit/release, but the reporter does not demonstrate building that fixed MAVROS revision against 2025.12.12. The reported successful downgrade is a different composition, not verification of the forward fix.
